series_start_reason: J&J prints no Rybrevant line in any schedule before 2025Q1 (absent from every 2021Q1-2024Q4 schedule, measured; probably inside Other Oncology - inferred). The 2025Q1 schedule's Supplemental Sales Information table gives 2023 only as a full year (93; US 66, Intl 27) and 2024 quarterly (47, 69, 89, 122). 2021Q2-2023Q4 quarterly figures are not printed anywhere I found, so the series starts at 2024Q1.

approval_evidence.quote: On May 21, 2021, the Food and Drug Administration granted accelerated approval to amivantamab-vmjw (Rybrevant, Janssen Biotech, Inc.)

search_log: Downloaded J&J's quarterly sales schedule PDFs 2021Q1-2026Q2 from the URLs of the existing J&J manifest (investor-site q4cdn); parsed every page with pdfplumber and searched case-insensitively for CARVYKTI, TECVAYLI, TALVEY, RYBREVANT, and the generic names (cache/jnj_rows.json).

Listed J&J 10-Q and 10-K filings 2021-2026 via data.sec.gov submissions (form 10-Q and 10-K only, no 8-K scan) and searched the primary documents for the four brand names: they appear only in prose or litigation text, only in narrative sentences (the only lines with a brand name and a number were prose).

Supplemental Sales Information schedules (Schedule 2 / 'Supplemental Sales Information' page) in the 2024Q1 and 2025Q1 schedules restate product lines quarterly; the 2024Q1 one carries Tecvayli, the 2025Q1 one carries Rybrevant/Lazcluze and Talvey.

The line is labelled RYBREVANT / LAZCLUZE in J&J's 2025+ schedules, whose footnote reads 'Includes the sales of RYBREVANT and RYBREVANT + LAZCLUZE'. The 2024 quarters exist only as restated in that table; the 2024Q1-Q2 figures pre-date Lazcluze availability, so the label's definition widens inside the series (flagged for the verifier; not split because J&J prints one restated line).

Launch quarter not established from an issuer document: J&J (CIK 200406) 10-Q/10-K 2021-05..2022-03 searched for Rybrevant/amivantamab near launch/commercial: none (10-Qs 2021Q2 and Q3 contain 0 mentions; 10-K FY2021 lists it only as an FDA approval).; J&J 8-K exhibit 99.1 for 2021Q2, Q3, Q4 mention RYBREVANT only as press-release headings for FDA/CHMP/EC approval; no launch or sales statement.; J&J press releases on jnj.com found via search state only 'accelerated approval in May 2021'; nothing states first commercial sale. Launch quarter not established.
